message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__decode_jpeg_header","line":3092,"var":"z->scan_n","code":"if (z->scan_n < 1 || z->scan_n > 4 || z->scan_n > (int) z->s->img_n) return stbi__err(\"bad SOS component count\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The JPEG scan header is accepted for a single-component grayscale image, allowing the decoder to proceed to the image reconstruction phase."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3157,"var":"c","code":"if (c != 3 && c != 1 && c != 4) return stbi__err(\"bad component count\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The grayscale frame uses a supported component count, so the image is not rejected before decode."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3212,"var":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data","code":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data = stbi__malloc_mad2(z->img_comp[i].w2, z->img_comp[i].h2, 15);","note":"The decoder allocates the per-component workspace using the parsed dimensions, which is the buffer later consumed by the resampler."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3759,"var":"r->hs","code":"r->hs      = z->img_h_max / z->img_comp[k].h;","note":"For grayscale, the horizontal scale factor collapses to 1, which routes decoding through the simplest upsample path."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3767,"var":"r->resample","code":"else if (r->hs == 1 && r->vs == 2) r->resample = stbi__resample_row_v_2;","note":"If the vertical factor were 2, the decoder would use the dedicated vertical resampler that assumes a well-formed row pair."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_v_2","line":3327,"var":"out[i]","code":"out[i] = stbi__div4(3*in_near[i] + in_far[i] + 2);","note":"This sink performs row interpolation directly from neighboring rows; the issue hypothesis is that malformed JPEG geometry can cause this sink to operate on an invalid row pairing and corrupt output."}
]
JSON
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
